# TimeLift (타임리프트)

> TimeLift is an AI voice planner. Say your tasks and Tami turns them into a daily plan, then rings you like a phone call when it is time. To-dos, time blocking, Pomodoro, morning briefing, meeting notes, Mandalart and vision board.

타임리프트는 말하면 계획이 끝나는 AI 비서 플래너예요. 할 일을 말하면 타미가 하루 시간표로 정리하고, 시간이 되면 전화처럼 알려 줘요. 투두, 타임블로킹, 뽀모도로, 모닝 브리핑, 회의록, 만다라트, 비전보드까지.

## Key facts
- Name: TimeLift (Korean: 타임리프트). AI assistant inside the app: Tami (타미).
- Category: AI planner / to-do / time management app.
- Platforms: iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Mac. Google Play (Android) returns in December 2026.
- Origin: started on December 5, 2025 in a hotel room in Abu Dhabi, UAE, by a developer who used a paper planner on frequent business trips.
- Timeline: web version launched (February 2026); time blocking and Pomodoro beta (March 2026); first Android launch and the "Tami robot" idea (May 2026); Tami who calls you, call screen, alarms, social-blocking focus mode, watch prototype (July 2026); Tami morning briefing (October 2026); speak-to-plan, meeting notes, account backup, App Store 2.9.5 (November 2026).
- Price: free to download.
